extras: Local-first design ensures no data leaves the vault; supports JSON export/import with diff previews.
motivation: To provide a local-first, portable library of AI prompts that remains readable and searchable within the vault without requiring network calls or external accounts.
problem: Users struggle to organize, search, and efficiently reuse complex AI prompts within their notes without relying on external services or losing local control.
summary: A local-first library for managing AI prompts in Obsidian, allowing categorization, fuzzy search, and variable-based reuse without network calls.
